'''First Husband''' was a title given to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during the time that his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], with his wife, Chief of State [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
